name: booboo
description: Query your AI system's wiring, knowledge, memory, agents and crons as one rooted graph over MCP.
long_description:
Booboo turns a scattered AI system into one rooted graph an agent can actually query. Point it at a snapshot built by `booboo build` and it answers the questions that otherwise cost a human an afternoon: what feeds what, which cron owns this table, what did we decide about X and when, which agent is responsible for this surface.

It is also writable. With a journal beside the snapshot, agents can record decisions and reports as they work, and replay them on the next boot — so the graph is a live memory rather than a static export.

Open-core, MIT licensed. Build a snapshot with `npx create-booboo`.

snapshot.title: Booboo snapshot
snapshot.description: The graph.json produced by `booboo build`. Scaffold one with `npx create-booboo`.

org.title: Organigram (optional)
org.description: An org.booboo.json file. Supplying it adds the booboo_boot and booboo_org tools, so agents boot from the org tree.

readonly.title: Read-only
readonly.description: Leave off to let agents record decisions and reports into the journal beside your snapshot. Turn on to expose query tools only.
